item.title: Will the Middle Platform Disappear Under AI Agents?
item.description: 1. Business Bypasses the Middle Platform At the moment I work on Infra at a fairly large AI middle-platform team. After a department meeting early this year, I started wondering whether the middle platform would disappear. OpenClaw was very popular at the time. Business colleagues using OpenClaw with a large model could already get a great many things done without cooperating with other teams — the division of labor disappeared.
